subject: Mutual Action Plan: evaluation success criteria, exit gates & close timeline
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@finovalabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Clark <devon@finovalabs.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro and next steps

Karthik — thanks for the demo last week. Devon and I discussed priorities and we'd like a concise mutual action plan to land a short evaluation with clear exit gates.

High level goals for Finova:
- Validate inference latency under production mix (peak 120 qps, baseline 20 qps)
- Confirm response quality on our 50-case compliance prompt set (no more than 3 regressions total)
- Ensure encryption + audit logs meet procurement checklist

Can you propose a MAP that includes concrete acceptance tests, owners, and a proposed close timeline (we're targeting a purchase decision by end of Q3). I'll attach our eval corpus and a quick procurement checklist in my next email.

Thanks,
Maya
Head of Platform, Finova Labs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@finovalabs.com>
Cc: Devon Clark <devon@finovalabs.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan request — draft MAP attached

Maya — thanks, this is exactly what we want to align on. Draft MAP attached (Finova-MAP-v1.xlsx) and pasted key acceptance criteria below to keep things actionable.

Summary (proposed):
- Timeline: 6 week technical evaluation (start: 2026-06-08, finish: 2026-07-20), 2-week procurement & legal review, target close by 2026-08-03 if acceptance tests pass.
- Success criteria (must pass all to move to purchase):
  1) Performance: P95 generation latency <= 300ms on 75-token average prompt at peak traffic profile (120 qps) for a sustained 10 minute window; no P1 timeouts in 99.9% of calls.
  2) Throughput: sustained 100 qps with <5% tail amplification errors for 30 minutes during stress window.
  3) Accuracy/Quality: Pass rate >= 94% on Finova 50-case eval (binary pass/fail per case defined in eval-testset.csv). No more than 3 cases can regress compared to baseline.
  4) Security & Compliance: KMS integration verified, audit logs accessible via provided API, SOC2 evidence checklist items 1–6 validated.
  5) Operational readiness: automated alerts for error rate spikes + playbook for fallback to smaller model variant.

Owners and suggested owners:
- Redwood technical lead (config & tuning): Karthik Iyer
- Finova test lead (eval runs & pass/fail decisions): Maya Patel
- Security/evidence coordination: Laura Bennett (Redwood) + Devon Clark (Finova)
- Procurement & legal: Jonas Weber (Redwood) looped in for T&Cs

Exit gates (hard):
- All security checklist items marked done; audit logs delivered and signal traces for sampled requests verified
- Performance acceptance tests meet thresholds in two independent runs separated by 48 hours
- Eval pass rate >= 94% on the canonical testset

Optional: If any single hard gate fails, we trigger a two-week remediation period; if remediation fails, we move to contract terms with reduced SLAs for a pilot (documented in MAP).

I attached a proposed test schedule in the worksheet and an eval-testset.csv for immediate import. Next step: can we lock the start date (we're tentatively scheduling a sandbox for you on 2026-06-08)?

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attach: Finova-MAP-v1.xlsx, eval-testset.csv
From: Devon Clark <devon@finovalabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@finovalabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan request — draft MAP attached

Karthik — quick clarifying Qs from procurement/security after skimming the MAP:
- For the P95 latency test, do you provide a replay harness so we can reproduce the peak traffic mix?
- What exact SOC2 artifacts will be available during the evaluation (do you share the full report or just excerpts/attestations)?
- Can we require a one-week read-only access to audit logs during the evaluation?

If you can confirm those three items we'll propose the MAP to our procurement committee on Monday.

Thanks,
Devon
Director, IT Security — Finova Labs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Clark <devon@finovalabs.com>, Maya Patel <maya@finovalabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan request — draft MAP attached

Devon — answers inline below. Quoting for clarity.

> For the P95 latency test, do you provide a replay harness so we can reproduce the peak traffic mix?
Yes — Redwood will provide a traffic replay harness (script + load profile JSON) and a reference harness run that replicates our internal tests. We'll include instructions for client-side measurement and an agreed set of nodes to ping. Owner: Karthik.

> What exact SOC2 artifacts will be available during the evaluation (do you share the full report or just excerpts/attestations)?
We share a SOC2 Type II summary report and point-in-time attestations; full report access is via NDA or enterprise engagement. For the evaluation period we can provide scoped evidence for the audit checklist items requested in your procurement sheet (encryption, access controls, change management). Owner: Laura Bennett.

> Can we require a one-week read-only access to audit logs during the evaluation?
Yes — we can grant read-only access to a filtered audit-log view for the evaluation window (logs are redacted for PII by default). We'll share the API endpoint and example queries prior to the first run. Owner: Laura Bennett.

I'll update the MAP with these confirmations and propose the hard start of 2026-06-08 as long as Finova drops the eval-testset and confirms sandbox IP allowlist by end of day Friday 2026-06-05.

Jonas — looping you on the acceptance/remediation language in case procurement needs contract language tweaks.

Best,
Karthik
From: Maya Patel <maya@finovalabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Devon Clark <devon@finovalabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan request — draft MAP attached

Thanks — this is helpful and actionable. We reviewed the updated MAP and confirm the following:
- Finova will start the evaluation on 2026-06-08; sandbox allowlist & eval-testset delivered today.
- We accept the acceptance criteria as enumerated. Two clarifications we want documented in the MAP worksheet:
  a) Regression definition: a regression is any case where Redwood output fails the binary pass condition in eval-testset.csv.
  b) Acceptance measurement runs: results will be from two independent runs (24–48 hours apart) using the provided replay harness; the higher pass rate of the two runs determines the pass/fail for quality.

If those two bullets are added, we can sign off and schedule the procurement review for 2026-07-22. Please update the MAP and share final version and HubSpot link.

Best,
Maya
Head of Platform, Finova Labs
Attachment(s): none
